description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline benchmark. Encodes queries with a BERT-like encoder, retrieves top-k documents by cosine similarity, then generates text with a GPT-2-like decoder using cross-attention to retrieved context. Reports queries/sec throughput.

scaling_param.name: num_docs
scaling_param.description: Number of documents in the retrieval corpus

non_scaling_params.name: top_k
non_scaling_params.description: Number of documents retrieved per query

non_scaling_params.name: generate_len
non_scaling_params.description: Number of tokens to generate in the response

non_scaling_params.name: num_layers
non_scaling_params.description: Number of transformer layers in encoder and generator

non_scaling_params.name: hidden
non_scaling_params.description: Hidden dimension of encoder and generator
